title: Unblocking evidence
current: A blocker at done always satisfies fact:merged regardless of edge age. For an unfinished blocker, fact:merged requires its recorded merged_at strictly after the edge’s created_at. Earlier landings, branch ancestry and other lifecycle statuses cannot clear an unfinished blocker’s newly declared wait. Create a new edge before a needed re-landing; updates preserve the clock. Each durable edge owns its dependency notice identity. For correction waits, status:done requires completion; fact:deployed:ENV also requires durable completion attribution to that registered environment. Same-run co-scheduling permits admission, not persisted satisfaction or proof of an available retest target. Reread all remaining blockers on any notice.
